notes.title: Xbox Gamepad Support!
notes.content:
This release adds full gamepad support, ensuring that all prompts, menus, and gameplay in [b]Swashbuckler's Xmas[/b] work on both Xbox controllers as well as keyboard/mouse. We're really excited about this release, since it will make it a lot easier for kids and anyone who prefers gamepad to enjoy Captain Smokey's adventure.

[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Use input action icons in help text
[*] Don't select targets that are not in the field of view
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix alignment issue on main menu for some resolutions
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 27, 2025
notes.content:
This patch contains a few small enhancements and a number of bug fixes.

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Catapults have much better aim now
[*] Improved hockey mode camera
[*] Added ambient sound to main menu
[*] Added UI sounds
[*] Slightly improved gamepad button styles
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed timing and UI issues with narrator dialogue in ending cinematic
[*] Fixed random skating noises in Elfton
[*] Fixed an issue where the Dopplegangers would skate off the map
[/list]

notes.title: Update #1: Catapults, more enemies, and bug fixes
notes.content:
Ahoy! This first update includes some more and different enemies to handle in Elfton as well as a few bug fixes.

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added catapults to Elfton
[*] Added more elves to Elfton
[*] Improved enemy AI
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed enemies appearing out of thin air
[*] Fixed continue game flow
[/list]
